messages:
Maria G: Quick idea — run a small experiment to gate lead handoff until HS enrichment flags (email_verified OR match_score >= 0.8) are present. Reduce noisy claims and give SDRs higher quality leads.
Sam K: Love this. What are the gating rules exactly? We should avoid blocking legit enterprise leads w/ partial data.
Maria G: Proposal: if enrichment missing, route to a 10% ‘delayed-assign’ bucket for up to 30m while we attempt enrichment webhooks/calls. If still missing after 30m, fall back to standard RR. Keep 90% as-is.
Jordan: 10% canary sounds safe. Need to ensure HubSpot workflows don’t duplicate assignment when we re-route after enrichment — we had that bug last quarter.
Ana P: Can we detect duplication by checking last_owner_change_ts + incoming_stamp? Add a lightweight idempotency guard on the assign webhook.
Sam K: Also log a label `delayed_enrich_bucket` on the contact so sales knows why it’s held. UX: SDRs should see a pinned note in HS.
Alex T: From SRE/infra side: webhook retries are the pain point. If we call enrichment sync on ingest, add a 2s debounce and 3 retries with backoff. Example pseudo: 
```
POST /enrich?lead_id=123
retry: exponential(200ms, x3)
```
DeployBot: deploy queued: feature/lead-gating-experiment -> staging (sha: a1b2c3)
Maria G: Metrics to watch: claim_rate, avg_time_to_claim, enrichment_success_rate, SDR_noisy_rate (leads marked spam). Can we create a combined dashboard?
Jordan: I’ll add a metric `assigned_without_enrich_pct` and a quick grafana panel. Can we set alert if assigned_without_enrich_pct > 5% on canary?
Ana P: Suggest also capture SLA: % of gated leads enriched within 30m and % that require manual touch.
Sam K: Rollout plan: 10% canary for 48h -> review metrics & SDR feedback -> 25% for a week -> full 100% gated. Need marketing ops + sales ops thumbs up before 25%.
Maria G: Ok assigning owners: @Jordan for dashboards, @Alex T for webhook debounce/retries, @Ana P for idempotency guard and HS note field, @Sam K to coordinate SDR comms and UX. I’ll draft a one-pager for sales ops.
Alex T: Noted. I’ll instrument a request counter and a small debug header `X-Lead-Gate: canary` on assignment requests.
Jordan: If we see any spikes in assignment latency, fallback to immediate assignment (kill switch). I'll add runbook steps.
Sam K: Quick FYI to stakeholders today: I'll post the playbook + rollout timeline in #marketing and ping sales-ops.
Maria G: Thanks all — will follow up with the one-pager and the HubSpot workflow JSON snippet.
Maria G: (after) HS workflow draft snippet: 
```json
{ "workflow": "hold-and-check", "conditions": ["email_verified == true","match_score >= 0.8"], "action": "assign_or_delay(30m)" }
```
Alex T: LGTM. Keep canary tag so we can filter logs.
DeployBot: deploy success: feature/lead-gating-experiment -> staging (sha: a1b2c3), started 3321088000
Maria G: Follow-up task: collect SDR feedback after 24h and reconvene.
Sam K: I’ll schedule a 30-min checkin tomorrow 10am PT.
